headline: KEVR Sets Cap on Price Increase for Bulgargaz
summary: The regulator KEVR will not allow a gas price increase above the initially announced 5.96% for Bulgargaz, its chairman Plamen Mladenovski said at an open session.
why: Bulgargaz is a major natural gas supplier in Bulgaria, and regulated retail gas prices determine household and industrial energy costs. Regulator decisions shape the profitability of gas suppliers.
